summary: John's 11th-great-grandfather (via Rachel Browne → Elisabeth Salmon → Sarah Horton); well-known Southold founder from Mowsley, Leicestershire.
bio: Listed by Round 3 among the English origins: Mowsley, Leicestershire, with 'Joseph & Libbeus Horton of Mowsley' as the earliest known Hortons there. His descendants also include the Southold Hortons who married into the Tuthills (Mary Tuthill m. Jonathan Horton; Bethia Horton m. Henry Tuthill the Justice), though those lines are collateral.
